design.seed_formula: 2040000000 + noise_index*10000000 + order_index*1000000 + wheel*100000 + initial*10000 + cohort_index*1000 + repetition

wheel_measurement_profiles.name: nominal
wheel_measurement_profiles.basis: same uncalibrated sensitivity assumptions as prior R84-R4

wheel_measurement_profiles.name: stressed
wheel_measurement_profiles.basis: explicit uncalibrated sensitivity stress, not a device specification

analysis.calibration: within each IMU noise, known three-axis order, initial state and wheel profile; pool healthy calibration across three nominal target-wheel design levels
analysis.primary_sample_unit: one native execution with two paired wheel-observation profiles
analysis.imu_score: split 271 native samples into three overlapping 91-point 18-second blocks, rebase time, compute unchanged R84-R2 16 gyro features per block, calibrate robust-z separately per block and take the maximum across blocks
analysis.wheel_command_score: split paired wheel observations into three overlapping 18-second blocks, rebase source time, compute unchanged R84-R4 log response gain for each of three wheel channels per block, calibrate nine dimensions and take the maximum
analysis.threshold: nearest-rank 90th percentile of healthy calibration scores separately for IMU, wheel_command and fusion
analysis.abstention: wheel_command and fusion abstain when any required wheel gain is missing or fewer than 80% healthy calibration gains are valid; keep all assigned seeds in denominator
analysis.comparisons: independent healthy false alarm, loss50, loss75 by noise profile, wheel profile, axis order, target wheel and initial state; report exact counts; do not causally attribute differences from earlier 18-second single-axis study to axis coverage alone because duration and exposure differ
analysis.method_selection: no post-hoc feature, threshold, or profile selection; all methods reported
analysis.qualification: research only, no R85 dataset eligibility or flight/Stable claim
